notes.title: New 100% FREE game coming soon!
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

My 12th game is coming to Steam on December 4th! Make sure to wishlist it so that you can enjoy destroying mossy surfaces pixel-by-pixel as soon as it gets released! 😊

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2618370/Mossy_Pixels/

P.S. It's 100% free, with no microtransactions or other nonsense. The only way to toss a coin into this game is to purchase a "donation" DLC below 😉:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2696990/Mossy_Pixels_Lucky_Find/

I hope you'll enjoy it as much as I enjoyed making it. Have a great day! 💖

Kind regards,
Ivan (Khud0)

notes.title: Kickstarting my next FREE Steam game!
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

My 12th Steam release is going to be another relaxing [u]free[/u] game! If you'd like to take a part in this project and get your name inscribed in it, please consider supporting it over on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/khud0/mossy-pixel]Kickstarter[/url]. <3

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44403952/b2cce5a001b2b660dc0eee6b58e17366108162b1.gif[/img]

And don't forget to wishlist Mossy Pixels on Steam, so that you can enjoy destroying mossy surfaces pixel-by-pixel as soon as it gets released!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2618370/Mossy_Pixels/

This game [u]will[/u] be released and [u]will[/u] be [u]100% free for everyone[/u], regardless of whether it reaches its funding goal or not. However, your support would greatly help me stay on track and keep making 1 free game per year in the future!

Speaking of which, don't forget to grab my previous free game, in case you missed it!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2067760/Trash_Bomber/

Thank you for playing my games and for considering helping me out. Have a wonderful day! :)

Kind regards,
Ivan (Khud0)
